name: pi-models
description: Use any model served by an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, a gateway) side by side with Claude. Every step whose model id starts with local/ is answered by the server the user configures; every other step goes to Claude untouched.

url.title: Messages endpoint
url.description: The server's Anthropic Messages endpoint, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/messages.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Sent as the API key when not empty. It travels in a config on curl's stdin, never on a command line.

maxTokens.title: Max output tokens
maxTokens.description: The max_tokens each routed request asks for.
